user.title: Select your bank
user.description: Choose your bank to pre-fill the connection settings, or select **Other / Custom** to enter them manually.

credentials.title: Connect to {bank}
credentials.description: Enter your online banking credentials. You need a FinTS product ID (Produktkennung) registered with your bank.

data_description.product_id: Your registered FinTS product ID. Must be obtained from your bank.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FinTS connection
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings. Leave PIN empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the FinTS server. Check the endpoint URL.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Verify your PIN and username. Some banks also require a fresh web portal login — try logging into your bank's website first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This bank connection is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll your bank for updated balances. Minimum 300 s (5 min). Default is 3600 s (1 h).

auth_failed.title: FinTS authentication failed for {bank_name}
auth_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not log in to **{bank_name}** via FinTS.

Possible causes:

1. **Stale web session**: Some banks (e.g. ING) periodically require you to log into their web portal before FinTS access is re-enabled. Visit your bank's website, log in, then reload this integration.
2. **Changed PIN**: If you recently changed your online banking PIN, use **Reconfigure** to update it.

After resolving the issue, go to **Settings → Devices & services → {bank_name}** and select **Reload**.
